blocks.text: Derived units woh units hain jo base units se bante hain. Kuch derived units Table 1.2 mein hain. Plane angle aur solid angle ke units bhi 1995 se derived units ki list mein shamil hain.
Base aur derived units ke ilawa SI kuch aur units ki bhi ijazat deta hai, jaise:

items: Angle napne ke purane mathematical (hisaab wale) units: degree, arcminute aur arcsecond.
Waqt ke purane units: minute, hour, day aur year.
Logarithmic unit bel (aur us ke multiples, jaise decibel).
Rozmarra zindagi ke do metric units: volume ke liye litre aur bare masses ke liye tonne (metric ton).
Do non-metric scientific units: atomic mass unit (u) aur electron volt (eV).
Nautical mile aur knot: yeh samandar aur meteorology (mausam ki science) mein istemal hote hain.
Acre aur hectare: zameen ka area napne ke units.
Bar: pressure ka unit; meteorology mein millibar aur engineering mein kilobar ki shakal mein istemal hota hai.
Angstrom aur barn: physics aur astronomy mein istemal hone wale units.

blocks.alt: Mass (kg) ka vertical (khara) scale, upar 10⁻³⁰ se neeche 10³⁰ tak, har 5 powers of ten par nishan. Saath upar se neeche: electron, proton, uranium atom, DNA molecule, cell, machhar (mosquito), kitab, car, oil tanker, Mount Everest, Zameen aur Suraj.
blocks.caption: Kuch masses ka order of magnitude (Interesting Information; kitab ke chart ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.text: Kitab atomic mass unit ka symbol µ (Greek letter mu) chhapti hai. µ to prefix micro ka symbol hai. Atomic mass unit ka sahi symbol u hai.
blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti

blocks.text: Is scale par har bara nishan pichhle se 10⁵ guna (ek lakh guna) bhari hai, is liye electron (taqreeban 10⁻³⁰ kg) aur Suraj (taqreeban 2 × 10³⁰ kg) ek hi chart par aa jate hain. Har cheez ka nishan us ke mass ka order of magnitude (10 ki power) batata hai: kitab taqreeban 1 kg = 10⁰ kg, car taqreeban 10³ kg, Zameen taqreeban 6 × 10²⁴ kg.
